snippet.title: Lisia - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Lisia, an anime offroading adventure game developed by Roxych. Players will take on deadly and dangerous roads alone or with friends in co-op. Design trucks, use the winch to help others on the road, and overcome challenges across multiple biomes. Lisia is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
